description:
LIVE, INVEST, OR DO BOTH ON THE WILD ATLANTIC WAY !

8-Bedroom Detached Residence on the Wild Atlantic Way | Substantial Site | Development Potential

PROPERTY OVERVIEW

An exceptional opportunity to acquire an eight-bedroom detached property, superbly positioned on the Wild Atlantic Way approximately 2km west of Spiddal, Co. Galway.

Offering an impressive level of accommodation, generous outdoor space and excellent flexibility, this property represents a rare opportunity in this highly desirable part of west Galway.

The property extends over two storeys and provides eight bedrooms, all of which benefit from their own private ensuite facilities. The accommodation is ideally suited to a large family, multi-generational living, guest accommodation or purchasers seeking a property with considerable versatility and future potential.

The property also includes a large and spacious kitchen/dining area, providing an excellent setting for family gatherings and entertaining. A further en-suite room to the rear provides valuable flexibility and could be utilised as a home office, study, playroom, hobby room or additional living space. Externally, to the rear of the property is a utility room and services room.

Generous Site with Future Potential
A particular feature of this property is the generously sized site. As well as plenty of room for parking and outdoor entertaining, thid 0.21 hectare site with frontage to the Wild Atlantic Way may provide potential for future development or further enhancement of the property, subject to planning permission and all relevant statutory approvals.

This creates an exciting opportunity for purchasers looking for a property with scope to adapt, expand or potentially develop the site in the future.

Location
The property enjoys a superb coastal location on the Wild Atlantic Way, approximately 2km west of the popular village of Spiddal.

Spiddal offers a strong local community, shops, cafés, pubs, schools and a range of amenities, while the spectacular Galway coastline and surrounding Connemara landscape are right on the doorstep.

Galway city is accessible via the coast road, making the property an attractive option for those seeking the tranquillity and character of west Galway while retaining access to the city and its extensive range of services and employment opportunities.

The location also offers tremendous potential as a base for exploring the many attractions of the Wild Atlantic Way and Connemara.
